company_overview.name: Acme Services

company_overview.hours: Monday to Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST. 24/7 Emergency on-call support.

departments.name: Sales & Billing
departments.description: New service inquiries, quotes, contract renewals, invoices.

departments.name: Emergency Dispatch
departments.description: Critical outages, safety concerns, urgent on-site dispatches.

faq.question: What counts as an emergency?
faq.answer: Complete server outages, ransomware or security incidents, and total network downtime qualify for priority emergency dispatch.

faq.question: When are invoices due?
faq.answer: Invoices are net 30 days from invoice date. We accept ACH, credit cards, and wire transfers.

faq.question: How quickly can a technician visit on-site?
faq.answer: For contract clients, emergency on-site response is within 2 hours. Standard consultations are scheduled within 24 to 48 hours.
